correctness.rationale: The Mittag-Leffler series yields the two leading kernel powers. Their exact Gram determinant is alpha^2 T^(6 alpha-2)/((2 alpha-1)(4 alpha-1)(3 alpha-1)^2); multiplying by the squared coefficient determinant gives det W_T, while the trace gives the large eigenvalue. det/trace yields C_- and the exponent 4 alpha-1. The endpoint-map Gramian identity gives the exact worst-target minimum-energy formula.
